_how: Fill each key with the texture path or glyph spec printed by `python tools/stat_icons.py find <sao.zip>` (see the docstring). Empty = the site keeps its emoji. Check against an in-game tooltip (F2) – the same icon the game draws before that stat.
_look: Tooltips seen in screenshots: '?' before Minimum Level, a sword before Attack Damage / Physical Damage, a heart before Health, a chain before Life Steal, a star/cross before the set name.
